description.zh:
增量时间间隔，以秒（s）为单位。
> 仅支持物理备份。
description.en:
The interval at which you want to perform incremental log backups. Unit: seconds.

> This parameter takes effect only when physical backups are performed.

description.zh:
全量备份周期，取值如下：
- Monday：周一
- Tuesday：周二
- Wednesday：周三
- Thursday：周四
- Friday：周五
- Saturday：周六
- Sunday：周日

> BackupPeriod值必须指定每周至少两天，且日期间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en:
The day of each week when the full backup task runs. Valid values:

- Monday

- Tuesday

- Wednesday

- Thursday

- Friday

- Saturday

- Sunday
The ID of the backup schedule.

description.zh:
全量备份开始时间，取值：格式：HH:mm。

> 该参数必填。
description.en: The start time of the full backup task. Specify the time in the HH:mm format.

description.zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
- **simple**：周期备份，和BackupPeriod、BackupStartTime配合使用。
- **manual**：手动备份。

> 默认为**simple**。
description.en:
The backup method that you want to use for full backups. Valid values:

- **simple**: scheduled backup. If you specify this value for the BackupStrategyType parameter, you must also specify the BackupPeriod and BackupStartTime parameters.

- **Manual**: manual backup.

> Default value: **simple**.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs modify-backup-strategy --backup-plan-id dbstooi01XXXX --backup-period Monday,Tuesday,Wednesday --backup-start-time 14:22 --backup-strategy-type simple --backup-log-interval-seconds 1000 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dbs ModifyBackupStrategy --region cn-hangzhou --BackupPeriod 'Monday,Tuesday,Wednesday' --BackupStartTime '14:22' --BackupPlanId dbstooi01XXXX --BackupStrategyType simple --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --BackupLogIntervalSeconds 1000
